title: Order relative to authorizing the committee on Transportation to make an investigation and study of a certain current Senate document relative to enhance the safe use of micromobility devices.

abstracts.abstract: Senate, July 22, 2026 -- The committee on Transportation, to whom was referred the petitions Senate, May 4, 2026 - Message from Her Excellency the Governor recommending legislation to enhance the safe use of micromobility devices, report the accompanying Order (Senate, No. 3194).
